name: Choukyou Daikounin
source:
Main character Dick lives in poverty, but happily with his father. However, father unexpectedly dies in an accident leaving protagonist in charge of sister Riz. One day letter about debt repayment comes. Dick plans to deal with it tomorrow, but Riz slips away alone the same day. Dick is not allowed inside the mansion, and Riz is reported to have sold herself to repay the debts. Boy soon discovers that Riz is confined inside against her will and treated poorly. Mansion owner makes a business proposal - he will free Riz if Dick trains girl Remi to such a level that she can satisfy any customer's needs. And the 10 day training begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角迪克生活貧困，但和父親過得很幸福。然而，父親卻在一場意外中身亡，主角獨自一人照顧妹妹莉茲。有一天，關於償還債務的信來了。迪克打算明天處理這件事，但當天莉茲就獨自溜走了。迪克不被允許進入宅邸，據說，莉茲已經賣身來償還債務。男孩很快發現莉茲違背自己的意願被關在裡面，而且受到了惡劣的對待。豪宅主人提出了一個交易條件——如果迪克將女孩雷米訓練到能夠滿足任何顧客的程度，他就會釋放莉茲。為期10天的訓練開始了。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]］
